messages:
sara_support: FYI customer reported a sudden p95 latency increase on text-generation (API v2/generate). They provided two sample request IDs but no reproducible prompt set yet. Says it started after a few spikes yesterday. Asking for a repro pack so we can validate.

ashley_repl: Which model & exact endpoint? Do we have their reported token counts / concurrency?

sara_support: Model: `redwood/open-13b-v2` via hosted API. Customer reports ~20 concurrent clients, typical prompt ~80–140 tokens (avg ~120 tokens). Example IDs they gave: `req_20260307_aa1` and `req_20260307_ab2` (they're partials, asked to redact). They said p95 jumped from ~220ms to ~1.2s.

raj_oncall: Ok. We need the full X-Request-Id values (from their headers or logs), the raw request payloads (prompts), and a concurrency profile (start rate, steady-state, peak). Also capture response headers including `x-rw-request-id` and `x-rw-duration-ms`.

mike_sre: To make a reliable repro pack ask them to: 1) provide a small promptset (10-30 prompts) that represent typical traffic, 2) include token counts per prompt and target max_tokens, 3) run a short concurrency sweep (10, 20, 50) with timestamps, and 4) provide curl outputs or `wrk`/`k6` logs.

ashley_repl: Share this example curl for a single-shot repro (no secrets):

```bash
curl -sS https://api.redwood.example/v2/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/open-13b-v2","input":"<prompt from promptset>","max_tokens":120}' \
  -D - | sed -n '1,20p' # prints response headers then body
```

raj_oncall: For concurrency tests we usually recommend k6 or hey. Example k6 snippet to run a 30s steady at concurrency 50 and dump timing buckets: 

```js
import http from 'k6/http';
import {sleep} from 'k6';
export let options = {vus:50, duration:'30s'};
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.example/v2/generate', JSON.stringify({model:'redwood/open-13b-v2', input:'<one-prompt>', max_tokens:120}), {headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer <REDACTED>','Content-Type':'application/json'}});
  sleep(0.1);
}
```

mike_sre: Also useful: a short capture of the `x-rw-duration-ms` header per request and the server-side trace IDs. If they can send us a debug bundle (logs + curl ids) we can tie it to infra traces. Use the support tool: `ri-support collect-debug --req-ids req_... --include-logs` or upload via the support portal.

sara_support: I'll ask the customer to run the above and attach: promptset (plain txt), a small token-count CSV, one curl example per prompt, k6/hey logs for concurrency sweep, and the full request IDs.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy: inference-runtime/2026.03.07-hotfix deployed to prod at 1778234500 :rocket:

ashley_repl: Note: ask them to indicate whether they use prefix/KV caching or any client-side batching. That changes request latency profile a lot.

raj_oncall: If they can't run load tests, ask for a sample 10–15 prompts and we'll try to reproduce internally with equivalent concurrency. Please capture token counts (prompt + expected completion).

sara_support: Sent instructions to customer and requested upload link. Will paste their replies + full req ids here when available. :thumbsup:
